title: Timer-like counter with rollover

expected_function_roles.advance_counter: Advances a free-running counter and wraps it into the sixteen-bit timer range.
expected_function_roles.elapsed_ticks: Computes elapsed ticks across a rollover, reports a fixed stale threshold when the gap is too large, and otherwise clamps to a positive overflow limit.
expected_function_roles.main: Runs embedded behavior self-tests and returns zero only when all pass.
expected_function_roles.sample_probe: Passes all three probe inputs to the elapsed-time calculation.
expected_function_roles.timer_delta: Returns the difference between two counter readings, correcting for a single rollover.

constant_notes: TIMER_MODULUS 65536 is deliberately not claimed: the compiler proves the wrap is a sixteen-bit truncation and emits movzwl with no operand, so it is unrecoverable from the code even though those bytes occur incidentally elsewhere in the image. STALE_TICKS 3000 is the one domain constant that survives as an instruction immediate.
